scope: Static exact-file and original AST review only; no product imports, constructors, workload, native query, source edits or broad source/dependency scans. Current full source/input identity provided by separately retained exact rollback/current guards, not newly executed in this review.
launch_conditions: Independent security review and root ACK must exist and match exact reviewed hashes before launch.
Owned QA idle admission is not an external-host quiet claim.
One fixed native/CRT/CRT/native block only; failure/invalid/cleanup drift stops with retained observations and no retry/replacement.
limits: CRT removes native delete sharing/entry-only-open properties only on private controlled graph cache; it is not production security equivalence or an authorized fallback.

Wrapper adds dispatch/bookkeeping equally to both arms; observed consistent effects support an opener association in this controlled lifecycle, not an OS/antivirus cause or historical absolute attribution.

Existing finally:sdk.close and added unguarded exception.add_note can mask a primary if a secondary cleanup/note operation itself fails. Such a run remains failed/stopped, but exact primary-exception preservation is not certified by this review.

Worker output retains original exists-check/write_text publication rather than atomic exclusive-create; outer absent/ancestry guards and sole-owned writer admission apply. No hostile concurrent fixture/report writer safety claimed.
